lines.x: Global stock markets experienced severe sell-offs, with sharp drops spreading across Asian bourses and hitting European markets following heavy losses in US equities.

Equinor halted production at its Visund oil and gas platform in the Norwegian North Sea following an electrical switchboard room fire, removing 13.2 million cubic meters per day of gas export capacity.
AutoStore has increased its 2026 revenue guidance after reporting a jump in sales during the third quarter.
Norway's oil and gas production has relied on large discoveries made over half a century ago, with no major finds like the Wisting deposit in over a decade.
